rules.title: Repository identity
rules.description: Record Git branch and commit, or explicitly weak non-Git identity.
rules.evidenceRequirements: Captured Git metadata or manifest; never infer remote deployment.
rules.severityLogic: No finding; missing commit limits baseline strength.
rules.confidenceLogic: HIGH for captured metadata, UNKNOWN for remote identity.

rules.title: Dirty overlay
rules.description: Record source changes separate from HEAD.
rules.evidenceRequirements: Captured Git dirty counts and content manifest.
rules.severityLogic: No finding: active work is not a defect.
rules.confidenceLogic: HIGH for captured local state, UNKNOWN for release target.

rules.title: Agent instruction entry point
rules.description: Check for root AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md only.
rules.evidenceRequirements: Exact root path search; absence anchored to a captured root file.
rules.severityLogic: INFO documentation gap, not proof of absent governance.
rules.confidenceLogic: HIGH for exact path presence; scope limited to root.

rules.title: Decision record discoverability
rules.description: Check conventional root/docs architecture decision paths.
rules.evidenceRequirements: Bounded conventional-path search; no semantic quality judgment.
rules.severityLogic: INFO documentation gap only when a root anchor exists.
rules.confidenceLogic: MEDIUM because teams may use external decision records.

rules.title: Release guidance discoverability
rules.evidenceRequirements: Bounded conventional-path search; not runtime rollback proof.
rules.severityLogic: INFO documentation gap; never launch blocker alone.
rules.confidenceLogic: MEDIUM because host-native rollback may exist.

rules.title: Root package test script
rules.description: Inspect a valid root package.json for a test script.
rules.evidenceRequirements: Captured root package.json; not proof tests pass or other workspace scripts are absent.
rules.severityLogic: LOW configuration gap for a missing root script.

rules.title: Repository CI workflow
rules.evidenceRequirements: Captured workflow filename; external CI remains unknown.
rules.severityLogic: No finding for absence; provider CI may be external.

rules.title: Tracked sensitive configuration filename
rules.description: Detect tracked .env or credential-named paths without reading their content.
rules.evidenceRequirements: Stable pre/post Git index path list and excluded secret-candidate path; values never loaded.
rules.severityLogic: HIGH review candidate for path tracking; not proof a live secret exists.
rules.confidenceLogic: HIGH for path tracking, UNKNOWN for credential validity.

rules.title: Static entry title
rules.description: Check static root index.html for a nonempty title element.
rules.evidenceRequirements: Captured root HTML only; no rendered or live claim.
rules.confidenceLogic: MEDIUM because client rendering may add metadata.

rules.title: Static entry canonical
rules.description: Check static root index.html for canonical link.
rules.evidenceRequirements: Captured root HTML; generated canonical remains unknown.
rules.severityLogic: INFO source metadata gap; no ranking claim.

rules.title: Static entry language
rules.description: Check static root html element for lang attribute.
rules.evidenceRequirements: Captured root HTML; not WCAG conformance proof.
rules.confidenceLogic: HIGH for source element, UNKNOWN for rendered override.

rules.title: Static entry main landmark
rules.description: Check static root HTML for a main landmark.
rules.evidenceRequirements: Captured root HTML; dynamic component may supply landmark.
rules.severityLogic: INFO source gap only; not a rendered accessibility finding.
